title: Tokenization Matters: Navigating Data-Scarce Tokenization for Gender Inclusive Language Technologies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM misgendering and grammatical proficiency by using a constrained decoding approach to predict the correct pronoun in masked sentence templates, specifically measuring pronoun consistency (gender agreement), pronoun case agreement error, and adversarial injection error for both binary pronouns and non-binary neopronouns (e.g., xe, fae).
